lines: Naseeb aazmaane ke din aa rahe hain
couplets.en: The days to try our luck are drawing near.

lines: Qareeb un ke aane ke din aa rahe hain
couplets.en: The day they come is drawing near.

lines: Saba phir hamein poochhti phir rahi hai
couplets.en: The morning breeze is asking after us again.

lines: Saba phir hamein poochhti phir rahi hai
couplets.en: The morning breeze is asking after us again.

lines: Chaman ko sajaane ke din aa rahe hain
couplets.en: Soon it will be time to dress the garden.

lines: Abhi se dil o jaan sar-e-raah rakh do
couplets.en: Lay your heart and soul by the roadside now.

lines: Ki lutne lutaane ke din aa rahe hain
couplets.en: Soon we will be plundered and give ourselves away.

lines: Chalo Faiz phir se kaheen dil lagaayen
couplets.en: Come, Faiz, let us give our heart away again.

lines: Suna hai thikaane ke din aa rahe hain
couplets.en: I hear the days when we might find a place are near.
